turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious! A classic morning meal. Did you have a busy morning at the design firm after that, or did you get a chance to ease into your workday?

turns.text: It's always great when you can find time to step away and get a good session in at the fitness center, especially during a busy work week. How is the training for the spring 10K coming along? Are you incorporating those strength sessions into your prep?

turns.text: Exactly, yeah. The strength training definitely helps with overall endurance and keeping my joints stable. The 10K prep is going really well overall. I'm feeling much more confident about my pacing than I was a few weeks ago.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's awesome to hear. Pacing can be one of the trickiest parts to dial in, so it's great that you're feeling confident. Have you been doing most of your running outdoors, or have you been sticking to the treadmill?

turns.text: Mostly outdoors! With the weather clearing up, it's been nice to get outside. Speaking of which, I've also been trying to get back into cycling a bit more now that the paths around the city are clear.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, that's perfect. Minneapolis has some fantastic bike paths. Do you find you're able to bring your camera along on those rides, or do you prefer to keep your cycling and photography as separate hobbies?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I usually keep them separate because carrying a heavy camera on a road bike isn't the most comfortable. But sometimes I'll scout out nice spots while riding and then head back later specifically to shoot.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
